DPES-864 awaiting-summary parity fixtures: provenance

Baseline
  file:    bin/fm-awaiting-captain.sh
  commit:  976c13eed3bdcd62fd3c732be69e33d42eb0f3e1
  sha256:  3ba31d670506542a34b43e2e149f6ead0089c8d691b258301093930ac4533902

Reference programs
  ROWS_PY  heredoc at baseline lines 152-200, saved as reference/rows.py.txt
           sha256 86a3e74c6b3071989e2edd62d3b3b77d97848c40f0640695db7a31efb59638a0
  SHOW_PY  heredoc at baseline lines 204-267, saved as reference/show.py.txt
           sha256 e6110756e4ac16eb8354dc40129f264fc52a2c1ff46b89fd444a67616f8de91b
  Extraction is byte-checked against the saved copies before any case runs.

Interpreter
  Python 3.14.6, invoked as: python3 -I -c "$PROG" < stdin
  stdin and stdout encoding: utf-8, strict error handling.

Generation
  The developer-only generator runs each case's stdin through the reference program.
  It saves stdout, stderr and the exit status as stdout, stderr and exit in each case.
  The Rust code never produces expected values. cargo test reads only these files.
  The generator is not part of the repository.

Inputs
  Real tasks-axi list and show output from scratch homes, plus hand-written edge cases:
  CRLF, BOM, quoting, JSON escapes, surrogate pairs, lone surrogates, invalid UTF-8,
  and base64 padding. The real inputs contain no private markers.

Newlines
  Expected values were generated on POSIX. There CPython's stdin does not translate
  newlines, so a CR LF line keeps its CR (checked: stdin b"a\r\nb\r\n" reads as
  'a\r\nb\r\n'). The CRLF cases (show/crlf, rows/crlf-header, rows/crlf-rows) pin that.
  Windows stdin uses universal newlines and translates CR LF, so Windows newline
  behavior is not pinned by these fixtures.

Traceback rule
  A Python crash saves its full traceback. Rust prints only the final exception line,
  so the test requires exactly one stderr line equal to that final line. stdout is
  compared exactly, so output written before a crash is still checked.

Verification
  verify-e2e.sh: the real-mixed run's objects match e2e-list.stdout (MATCH).
  base64 non-strict model: 700,000 generated inputs (lengths 0-14, three alphabets)
           against binascii, 0 mismatches. Developer-only fuzz; not kept in the repo.
  whitespace set: checked against str.isspace over every code point, 0 mismatches.

Clock
  tests/fixtures/util-now-ms/now-ms.tsv: repr<TAB>int(float * 1000) from Python 3.14.6,
  generated by a developer-only script. Ten rows.
